subject:
Your Microsoft exam appointment is soon. Take your Required System
 Test now.
body:
**PLEASE DO NOT RESPOND TO THIS E-MAIL**

Reminder of your Scheduled exam

This is a reminder for your upcoming Microsoft Certification exam. Please be sure to mark your calendars and follow the steps below to prepare for your exam session. If you are unable to take your exam at your scheduled time, please be sure to cancel or reschedule your appointment at aka.ms/examcancelreschedule no later than 24 hours prior to your scheduled exam time.

NOTE: If you do not cancel or reschedule with 24-hour notice prior to your scheduled exam appointment, you will forfeit your exam fee and/or your company may incur a charge.


Where do I start?

If you haven’t already, complete the following before exam day:

  • Test your system now
  • Acquire an acceptable form of ID
  • Prepare your testing space


You should also review:

  • The OnVUE technical requirements you must meet to take an online test from your home or office.
  • Pearson VUE policies and procedures to learn how to prepare your testing space and learn about testing rules.
  • Policies and additional FAQs


One more thing…

To avoid any issues on your exam day, check in to start your exam 30 minutes before the scheduled start time. This allows you extra time to be prepared, but please note that it does not guarantee an early admittance or start time.

Appointment Details

Order Number: ‎0078-0607-4906 ‎

Exam: DP-600 - Implementing Analytics Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric - English (ENU)
   
Candidate: JONES WILLIAM A
Candidate ID: ‎MS1100967253‎
Registration ID: 523667686
   
Date: ‎Monday, January 12, 2026‎
Time: ‎09:15 AM India Standard Time‎‎
Appointment Length (Includes time to review the Candidate Agreement, instructions and tutorial, answer the exam questions, and provide comments; if the exam does not include labs, the time will be 20 minutes less than this by design) ‎120‎ Minutes‎
System test: ‎Test your system‎
Exam check-in:  ‎Check in to start exam‎
‎Check-in begins 30 minutes prior to the appointment time or, sign into your candidate website.‎
   

Reschedule Policy

If you need to reschedule your appointment, be sure to do it no later than 24 hours prior to your scheduled exam. If you do not reschedule your appointment 24 hours prior to your scheduled exam, you will forfeit your exam fee and/or your company may incur a charge.

Cancellation Policy

If you need to cancel your appointment, be sure to do it no later than 24 hours prior to your scheduled exam. If you do not cancel your appointment 24 hours prior to your scheduled exam, you will forfeit your exam fee and/or your company may incur a charge. 

Additional Information

The following data is deleted from the OnVUE system within 60 days:

• The recorded video of your testing session
• Your identification, such as license or passport

Your headshot is retained for security and use on your Score Report for the life of Certification. For country-specific data retention regulations please reference your local government agency. For additional questions or requests for photo deletion, please contact our operations team at https://home.pearsonvue.com/microsoft/contact.

Microsoft has several resources that will help you prepare for your exam. Explore the Microsoft Learn exam readiness zone with a host of resources to help increase your chances of passing the exam. Learn more about the exam experience, explore the exam sandbox to familiarize yourself with the exam UI, and consider taking a practice assessment. 

Do you know what to expect on the day of the exam? Watch these short videos from Pearson VUE to ensure you are prepared.

Pearson VUE's goal is to make your exam experience a pleasant one. We want to thank you for selecting Pearson VUE as your exam service provider, and we look forward to serving you again. Please feel free to contact us with your comments or questions. Our contact information can be found on our website: pearsonvue.com/contact.

Sincerely,

Pearson VUE

By Richard Seroter<mailto:rseroter@google.com>

Google Antigravity, Google AI Studio, and more. Use it at work as part of  
Vertex  
AI,<https://c.gle/ANnMTcYvZY0uQjYS5dEG4EgG8pHciLXbFw7ASNDKMDkKu1zmoBibq06gd_1bWFUVQ616GtRsaOHbE6qOo0EDWHrU-lykK6faOrfYiBf0d2d5Q4pwW4POGQPRLw7ukzgdkP7ywXz4ytfyLcSf7Cb79kFFFn8F8e4UKDelI7XGRquT2rftW0n1-ombCPjMF2NXmagXT7Nbzl66-wiviBZUAogeYvBODxmHbaB8IAnESoHpcVESXXY>  
and you might notice it being used in your favorite industry SaaS products!

The Application Design Center is now GA.

Design and deploy app infrastructure with ADC. With this GA  
release,<https://c.gle/ANnMTcZJwE3tU5uQ6kGKeZu0mpgBmkctQ0P7J8UyXWel-2VZ_c6hO9JRjeTjm-C1m5mJ2NhyGrPBZIxDUNQHHHfwrEX2qvCRVHXVg4CMjKa5v3kOrW1UGU7N0FmGpZemBAcpY3XdDwBD1viJTxFpXr_3UXwdsK8PmTlvDs89cbl7YdP0vxXlE3z6L8Sj3Y4il2Cgvy_sthr8lvKqto55zZPGwzyMGiVCYViXM2tuL6DAf5Vvp0NVALunSR5y>  
we now offer the ability to import existing  
Terraform,<https://c.gle/ANnMTcagsM0CvfTAq_OJNRBbpUUv4bCNspivl1UgVfUiqlZONeFL7eG9rEI0hiQ2k7E6JeO6juTG3U8NF65p_5vHfTZr8EWKXSCqYGbWZXJjh2P0SdqfLUvjw7Y39LBFZObgs-HNxnXAQUO9kyYhx63uwWHVCoQ-5vQMvcMhkDcS-vEUyiLhJaQZIYqb0m8V0H0c4kU8mO5kuC6Vem_vxWCUBeEPjeO2CELHD7rx-Os6Dg>  
work with VPC service  
controls,<https://c.gle/ANnMTcas9zC3C1Zv9A3LL7U69oIlCL8maf1R2M5pw3uMGskrXbvgfGNzhDPrVsIZiWDYI9WEQf35uKtDiTZ-aW8lo9MJJHYJmfJNAG8sNjk6tTh0UZrdumIwegVyMUSDVi3nECyZK7-4pzQAUEtQxOyPpveyQsyDWuKNMVyGWZhZ9OGvveMcP6zXZ2noxJiL2ZnJwmQKy0mCYdB6MfW58qSZnIr5SSlTQS8D_2p4oEi3hpVEqlkfaeEuXQ>  
take advantage of GitOps  
workflows,<https://c.gle/ANnMTcaavb5QuUCH7tghvwvErSl3aDplu9grPBKLIhdz3J9uRIuQsW8NdNGZbGda4IocGlf3FuTwEy7dS9kw79ZvufZ2dvAblnDlHdtR2K9IL1sp62P_jTzcVhBvtFOLmRLldC-eJTVDzeX9SLzUL18tMuuWrnVrQ9aUYnUsx6jzX3_Y5dotPpZbTsZGuvZ9lxKMRNczYaEzECYMcCWepX_UaUdkGyL2TImxO0tuiROIwYBNT9ENUrPiTfHRujw5nXE>  
leverage gcloud for remote  
control,<https://c.gle/ANnMTcY9Jk6Qr0jy0Dzt38A8VHu3WU7iEpfjzrzC-C6LaAaFx68OPVhiPNP373-gtqu0WG-Wj0VrYpHiIsr2WP7nZJHjdIRBrB_kXU9qJc-tuWiE1YFO3Lx0rTovs5wppTMMl8aL3Qml5uLMbs-1Ive6OQXz7Q7HmR_Fr_ALNBfIf9jEbwQPmWbisWSFDhGTLrKO-3__WbyDm6yH0Fs>  
and model apps that use a wider variety of Google Cloud services.

Google Cloud now speaks MCP.

We introduced fully-managed remote MCP  
servers<https://c.gle/ANnMTcZTIRxn7VYSrwRgnJk-okx82ZwXJVleNChDdt4A-6inuZW2gK7FzUMUx3vo7NxxtuxD83nmtSCNRgfZMvWY9hSmDTLAjsYi4wl3hmLOOIQibdgWJAHYAD_RBcikm3qrQ2FuLy8No0rUGB7S-NguqWiAJXmFwBv3Q28I5eTn_xNkp8nfzIJVVAKC244qRtFdl8AGCfTTN19z5i92_3NfO4l0PX6uPq-Y3JgIIzOTdzPxHnhNHmHkP2CBEV_TapM8WqZiaNqnbvoZGJAoC6OXisXBGBI2>  
for a first-set of Google services. It’s now easier to add agent tools for  
Google Maps, BigQuery, Google Compute Engine, and Google Kubernetes Engine.  
Read Romin’s getting started  
guide<https://c.gle/ANnMTcYuKV6LqA_Dn3uetMHpCFNtrKw_HkjIbeqmYayG4nvqGf1oU8rt1PcmIYIH3jMbCmBnkuWnhxCamPjFgE1AgGyJp0ojLkz3JdHwN0q_VP7JwO_wxCURfd7OrQTrXeaNLp3pxEXgKWwTJueubQlubGZEfMGvTG3CIc9_7HFlO_VVec392onECm0MpQrCO2rbnyFd4VbykOfmsK4T9hrtIXwW5hrX1AZs1EYJb0WfOw4EKFxv0gtJ4T18zA>  
to quickly onboard.

Do context-driven development with the Gemini CLI.

Our new Conductor  
extension<https://c.gle/ANnMTcbYbZ6g8i6VPjbj_hEZmGUiFrEdZpcIvlseTI5-_tOz6IyPH-nLC_bHbn4N9yicSSRyNtz2OBFAyoaUiUZPBASK0KRV5lq19f87iGPI6awx6WsdF2xMxINUdTtcIJaFOQMIdwZp1tu5H1AoJVY_Y-zWvuOYEfEXOh1odxNFFAIOQvY8Hu-u3NZw03ww5K7GmG7GVFJhSifU3OGfZF1uCnCP_6Wk7NvC9mvo1ziUfdp0r4W7qWA8hS_9XfciDSKXpA>  
helps you create the specs and memory you need to plan better, and guide  
your agent through delivery. It works with greenfield projects, but also  
existing brownfield codebases!

Cloud Technical Series: OnBoard Edition.

Kick off 2026 with an advantage! Master the latest Gen AI models and cloud  
tools at the Cloud Technical Series: OnBoard Edition on 28-29 January,  
2026. Register  
now!<https://c.gle/ANnMTcb86BtvVP_eJRdNwytiiYZJ8Unq-TxGcI-hKX6WoKqax1qolTN2ElE2AWS2G4xgJiTQKrHeFhPXTzoPfzHUjAE7x3o8g9TXo2M6KaJQ0qwWASSwfb2rEKtur7RMBQHWgH18aEOdVJJMWOosfNGWHPbD6-4REfHr52hekcG0euyCGLddWWhWw9hzUO5Vp89_-gIu4KJ3-i41B8Py7sWiYK0j_Wtf5TNi1wuhBEb8acS4V6RK4S-TNdXbr5P62c-pPCHlbLGt7EmZc7muWvI8KrPWZ7e-mDU_3DriZSXFVnd1gUM6V-dmsgIkzqdXYvbFfc21zxbxdwjGgNaCEaLBrdgZDIkljvgIeM9CEnDPLscyylP3apQgeGco1pc9tkekZK9c6sz-5wF5npqVIQgpAuc>

Watch this

Build better, and deploy faster. Martin combines Google Antigravity and  
Google Cloud Run to efficiently create and ship  
software.<https://c.gle/ANnMTcYOH3HqLaLYOSaSGu7RkkV0BqO9bmchSeEQAbGCDK5lP9LZnB5CdOGICpAeRjypVuZP6eXV4zB1hQFZ-5DWBcN4Hmj9cyofPY0Y1-un5eqm9czAzRaM1woyzlEmJGJjhxAiV6wtXbxIwW2uTZBtArrJdobmA2o>

Community cuts

Creating a document OCR solution with Gemini 3 Flash.

You can make MANY people happy by automating document processing. Juan  
explains<https://c.gle/ANnMTcby4W_YTu-ap6SPjS2Fr9-S_BkPurX3lSVNnYT3vId7BdLVeepavnCmHDVk3y3-4lsDdeiZtOgoq9TYfK92FiRdva5H33uaT_0AKpAj7hJE4gi-M1WvsuuiFlMIUzYhs_nmHnPrq9t5-Bq0Do5cbfa0zWJvXQbxw5NnJ23fLhGuDVn-5H6vsv9Eaxr4Ipsan6gxqihHdSkr3tQofnlOVYOnZu-g_mpfIlVy9KokxsMZgrH46GA18fkm9hmDoBF4HnJDyQb1n_HXCBo1TXit_Nt5fr4l1-U-eADs0nnX>  
how he used Gemini 3 Flash to build a solution for loan documents.

Building A2A agents with the Go ADK.

subject: Welcome to Labmentix  Induction Session Details & Project Submission
body:
Dear Candidate,

 

Greetings from Labmentix!

 

We are pleased to welcome you to the Labmentix Internship Program. As part of your onboarding process, you are required to attend a mandatory Induction Session scheduled for Today ,8th January 2026, at 12:00 PM.

 

This session is an essential part of the selection process and will provide you with a comprehensive overview of the internship structure, expectations, and next steps.

 

Additionally, to proceed further in the hiring process, we kindly request you to submit your resume prior to the induction session.

 

Please use the following link to upload your resume:

👉 https://forms.gle/zfdH4g9T35fk4hjw9

 

 

Timely submission of your resume is a critical requirement for your application to be considered.

 

We are excited to learn more about your skills and contributions, and we look forward to seeing you at the induction.

 

Welcome once again to Labmentix! We are confident this internship will be a valuable and enriching experience.

 

 

Warm regards,
HR Labmentix

subject: Next Steps for Your Application with Labmentix
body:
Dear Candidate,

Thank you for your interest in the internship opportunity at Labmentix. We are pleased to invite you to attend the Internship Orientation Session organized by Labmentix.

 

You will shortly receive further communication via email, which will include:

 

  • A detailed overview of the internship selection procedure
  • Information and instructions regarding the upcoming orientation session
  • Opportunities to engage with mentors and fellow candidates
  • Stipend Details: Upto ₹15,000, subject to performance during the internship

 

Your participation in this orientation is important, as it will allow us to better understand your background, skills, and interest areas, while also giving you insights into the program structure and expectations.

 

We kindly request you to remain attentive to your email inbox to ensure you receive timely updates and important instructions related to the onboarding process.


We appreciate the potential you bring to this opportunity and look forward to welcoming you as part of the Labmentix internship program.

Sincerely,
HR Labmentix

**PLEASE DO NOT RESPOND TO THIS E-MAIL**

Reminder of your Scheduled exam

This is a reminder for your upcoming Microsoft Certification exam. Please be sure to mark your calendars and follow the steps below to prepare for your exam session. If you are unable to take your exam at your scheduled time, please be sure to cancel or reschedule your appointment at aka.ms/examcancelreschedule no later than 24 hours prior to your scheduled exam time.

NOTE: If you do not cancel or reschedule with 24-hour notice prior to your scheduled exam appointment, you will forfeit your exam fee and/or your company may incur a charge.


Where do I start?

If you haven’t already, complete the following before exam day:

  • Test your system now
  • Acquire an acceptable form of ID
  • Prepare your testing space


You should also review:

  • The OnVUE technical requirements you must meet to take an online test from your home or office.
  • Pearson VUE policies and procedures to learn how to prepare your testing space and learn about testing rules.
  • Policies and additional FAQs


One more thing…

To avoid any issues on your exam day, check in to start your exam 30 minutes before the scheduled start time. This allows you extra time to be prepared, but please note that it does not guarantee an early admittance or start time.

Appointment Details

Order Number: ‎0078-0607-4906 ‎

Exam: DP-600 - Implementing Analytics Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric - English (ENU)
   
Candidate: JONES WILLIAM A
Candidate ID: ‎MS1100967253‎
Registration ID: 523667686
   
Date: ‎Monday, January 12, 2026‎
Time: ‎09:15 AM India Standard Time‎‎
Appointment Length (Includes time to review the Candidate Agreement, instructions and tutorial, answer the exam questions, and provide comments; if the exam does not include labs, the time will be 20 minutes less than this by design) ‎120‎ Minutes‎
System test: ‎Test your system‎
Exam check-in:  ‎Check in to start exam‎
‎Check-in begins 30 minutes prior to the appointment time or, sign into your candidate website.‎
   

Reschedule Policy

If you need to reschedule your appointment, be sure to do it no later than 24 hours prior to your scheduled exam. If you do not reschedule your appointment 24 hours prior to your scheduled exam, you will forfeit your exam fee and/or your company may incur a charge.

Cancellation Policy

If you need to cancel your appointment, be sure to do it no later than 24 hours prior to your scheduled exam. If you do not cancel your appointment 24 hours prior to your scheduled exam, you will forfeit your exam fee and/or your company may incur a charge. 

Additional Information

The following data is deleted from the OnVUE system within 60 days:

• The recorded video of your testing session
• Your identification, such as license or passport

Your headshot is retained for security and use on your Score Report for the life of Certification. For country-specific data retention regulations please reference your local government agency. For additional questions or requests for photo deletion, please contact our operations team at https://home.pearsonvue.com/microsoft/contact.

Microsoft has several resources that will help you prepare for your exam. Explore the Microsoft Learn exam readiness zone with a host of resources to help increase your chances of passing the exam. Learn more about the exam experience, explore the exam sandbox to familiarize yourself with the exam UI, and consider taking a practice assessment. 

Do you know what to expect on the day of the exam? Watch these short videos from Pearson VUE to ensure you are prepared.

Pearson VUE's goal is to make your exam experience a pleasant one. We want to thank you for selecting Pearson VUE as your exam service provider, and we look forward to serving you again. Please feel free to contact us with your comments or questions. Our contact information can be found on our website: pearsonvue.com/contact.

Sincerely,

Pearson VUE

subject: Important Update on AICTE Registration Status
body:
Dear Student,

Greetings from SmartBridge!

This is to inform you that, as you have not completed any fundamentals course so far, your current AICTE registration has been cancelled. This step has been taken to ensure clean and accurate program records.

Please take note of the following important points:

  • Since no fundamentals course has been completed, your existing AICTE registration has been cancelled.
  • If you are still interested, you will have an opportunity to enroll again in the new AICTE VIP cohorts, which will be launched in January.
  • As the current registration has been cancelled, the CSA 50% discount is no longer applicable.
  • To continue and benefit from future cohorts or certifications, you will need to enroll afresh once registrations reopen.

We request you to carefully note this update, as any delay in enrollment may lead to issues related to certification access and discount eligibility.

For further updates, please stay connected with official SmartBridge communication channels.

Warm regards,
Team SmartBridge
